acquisition_policy.oci_redirect: At most one HTTPS redirect for an approved registry-1.docker.io library/python blob digest to production.cloudfront.docker.com; fresh credential-free request; no second redirect.
acquisition_policy.unexpected_or_changed_inputs: REFUSE; no re-resolution, tag pull or version substitution

actual_core_metadata_active_edges.requirement: hf-xet<2.0.0,>=1.6.0; platform_machine == "x86_64" or platform_machine == "amd64" or platform_machine == "AMD64" or platform_machine == "arm64" or platform_machine == "aarch64"
uvloop>=0.15.1; (sys_platform != 'win32' and (sys_platform != 'cygwin' and platform_python_implementation != 'PyPy')) and extra == 'standard'

excluded: Boot ISO, guest kernel/modules/root composition, managed-task images, models, providers, private consumer source and private investigation evidence.

interpreter.identity_rule: Call the existing zpm.dependencies.interpreter_identity inside the verified native interpreter; bind its complete output to the production dependency plan. Do not infer SOABI or platform.

purpose: Native sealed installation and import/interface qualification; no service launch or managed task.
